metric_contract.quantiles: Type7 linear interpolation; MAE magnitude, percent
metric_contract.finite_horizon: Saved execution 1m CLOSE path from synchronized first native-entry minute close, NOT blended native fill; stop at original actual exit or horizon. 24h censoring informative. No highs/lows or executable fills assumed.
metric_contract.whole: Saved native settled receipt close MARK versus contemporaneous native average-open; average changes with split fills. Not same denominator as finite horizon.
metric_contract.winner_labels: Native fill ledger diagnostic net after allocated entry and exit commissions, excluding UNKNOWN signed funding; not per-asset authoritative native cash.
metric_contract.TP_price_flags: Side-signed fill price versus frozen first-leg P0 and completed actual blended VWAP separately; 1bp is descriptive tolerance, not optimized threshold.
metric_contract.allocation_net: side*(actual_fill_px-completed_native_avg)*qty - proportional actual_entry_commissions - native_exit_commission; diagnostic ex funding, no alternative equity.
metric_contract.zero_formula_mapping: PASSIVE omitted slots directly observed; FULL frozen wave vector not exported. Generic BTC_REDUCE reason alone cannot identify zero-wave fallback.
metric_contract.fixed_stop_warning: Original profitable/losing labels are hindsight. A new fixed stop censors subsequent recoveries, TPs and capital path; MAE tails do not establish optimal SL or alternative PnL.
